observations: Source breadth is substantial in general portrait, composition, lighting, and cinematography, but the target-specific overlay—Chinese cosplay conventions, costume/prop interaction, constrained distance and permission/safety conditions—is much thinner.
The scans cover English and Japanese extensively; Chinese-language professional first-hand instruction is repeatedly noted as sparse in composition, posing, field, lighting and cosplay sources.
Several curriculum or video records are only outlines/indexes or partial page descriptions. Their topic presence is not equivalent to read lesson evidence.
The source maps generally state that image pixels were not reviewed; this audit makes no visual-example claims.
serious_core_voids: Crowded Chinese cosplay venue field method and venue-specific constraint research (E/F/G)
Cosplay costume and prop interactions beyond sword/generic weapon examples, especially daggers, wigs, sleeves and scale (E)
End-to-end selection, coherent set delivery, cosplay-aware retouch/compositing, and integrity boundaries (H)
On-site failure detection and structured review loop (A/G)
important_but_narrower_gaps: Silhouette, visual rhythm and color weight in costume/prop frames (C)
Mixed LED/fluorescent/daylight and facial exposure variation (B/F)
Character/narrative expression contrasts and controlled posing demonstrations (D)
Simple, repeatable short motion work for cosplay (I)
